## Type of change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor (potentially breaking change to improve existing code)
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update

# Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project, and kept my code DRY
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] If changes were made to the Web app(s), I have included a gif, screenshot, or video of my changes
- [ ] If changes were made to the database schema, I have generated a migration file
- [ ] If changes were made to the data model, I will copy them into the data model at dbdiagram.io after they have been approved
